steps.text: Follow these steps exactly, then stop. 1. Call the subagent tool once with run_in_background set to true, description 'Reply with CHILD_OK', and prompt 'Reply with exactly the word CHILD_OK and nothing else.'. 2. Call send_message once with the subagent id from step 1 and message 'Now reply with exactly SECOND_OK.'. 3. In one model step, call steer_agent once and send_message once, both with the same subagent id: steer_agent with message 'Now reply with exactly STEERED_OK.', then send_message with message 'Now reply with exactly THIRD_OK.'. 4. Call send_message with subagent_id exactly '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222' (a subagent that does not exist) and message 'Please continue.', and observe that it fails. 5. Reply with the single word DONE. Do not use the bash tool.
